Event Calendar
Ticker status
Position / Earnings FOMC / Macro Opex Clean entry
📅 FOMC meetings — 8x/year. Next: Jul 29–30, 2026. Avoid opening new puts 2–3 days before.
📊 CPI releases — Monthly, ~2nd week. Spikes TQQQ vol significantly. Watch for red day entries.
💰 Mag7 earnings weeks — Q2: late Jul · Q3: late Oct. All leveraged ETFs correlated — treat as avoid for all.
🌐 Chip export / trade news — Can gap NVDL 20%+ overnight. Monitor headlines before entering NVDL positions.
Earnings dates from your ticker settings. FOMC, CPI, PPI, and Jobs report dates sourced from Federal Reserve and BLS 2026 release schedules. Not financial advice.
